summary: The protected roadmap stack, private server deployment, studacad.com DNS, and TLS are complete. Public launch remains blocked by a production-like database/auth environment, external providers, review attestations, monitoring, and restore/load/failure drills.

knownDefects.basis: No critical or high software defect is known from the completed local and protected integrated GitHub suites; production-like staging evidence remains required.

launchRisks.risk: studacad.com DNS, TLS, and a server-capable deployment were not provisioned.
launchRisks.disposition: Resolved 2026-08-20: authoritative DNS, TLS, and the owner-only Sites release-candidate deployment are active. Keep public access closed until the remaining gates pass.

launchRisks.risk: No production malware scanner exists for tutor evidence.
launchRisks.disposition: Tutor evidence uploads fail closed; do not launch tutor onboarding until provisioned and tested.

launchRisks.risk: Meet, transactional email, and WhatsApp production accounts and credentials are not provisioned.
launchRisks.disposition: Provider copies and meeting provisioning remain unavailable; complete test-account staging drills before launch.

launchRisks.risk: Qualified legal, privacy, safeguarding, and accessibility review attestations are absent.
launchRisks.disposition: Do not represent the policies or operating model as professionally approved.

launchRisks.risk: Monitoring, alert routing, backup restore timing, load tests, and failure drills have not run against production-like staging.
launchRisks.disposition: Run and sign the evidence checklist before go-live.

launchRisks.risk: The ordered roadmap existed as an unmerged stacked draft pull-request chain.
launchRisks.disposition: Resolved 2026-08-20: PRs #30 through #45 were updated, protected-check validated, and merged into main in dependency order.

launchRisks.risk: Online payment-gateway checkout is intentionally deferred.
launchRisks.disposition: Keep online deposits unavailable; only audited verified offline deposits issue one credit per whole BWP.

launchRisks.risk: A production-like Supabase database, private storage, authentication project, migrations, and initial admin are not provisioned and evidenced.
launchRisks.disposition: Keep account and transactional journeys fail-closed; provision staging, apply and verify migrations, configure auth, and attach isolation/journey evidence before public launch.
